title: Gerente de Unidade - Lagoa Vermelha
description:
Sobre nós:

A Argenta é uma empresa brasileira com uma longa história. Fundada em 1985, pelos irmãos Neco e Deunir Argenta, consolidou-se como uma referência no setor de varejo de combustíveis e lojas de conveniência no Brasil.

Nossa estrutura

Hoje, somos mais de 5,5 mil funcionários atuando em nove empresas que fazem parte do nosso ecossistema: Sim Rede de Postos, Sim Distribuidora, Sim Lubrificantes, Querodiesel, Charrua, A27, Aiva, Sim Aviação e Luiz Argenta.

Visão de Futuro

A Argenta busca constantemente reinventar-se e superar desafios, com a visão de construir um futuro melhor para seus funcionários, clientes e comunidade.

Somos um ecossistema sólido, com uma cultura forte e uma visão de futuro promissora. Buscamos talentos que queiram percorrer conosco este caminho.

Se você possui espírito de servir, de fazer sempre o melhor, de encantar quem está ao seu redor e é movido por desafios, a Argenta é o seu lugar e a oportunidade abaixo é para você!

Valorizamos e estamos comprometidos com todas as formas de inclusão e diversidade.

Quer trilhar sua história com a gente?

Estamos com a oportunidade de Gerente de Unidade, na cidade de Lagoa Vermelha - RS

Quais as responsabilidades do cargo?

  • Fazer gestão da unidade;
  • Garantir a entrega de resultados do negócio;
  • Atuar com metas de vendas e controles;
  • Liderar a equipe;
  • Desenvolver pessoas;
  • Fazer o relacionamento e fidelização de clientes;
  • Garantir que os processos organizacionais sejam executados;
  • Ser guardião dos valores da SIM e garantir a execução do nosso propósito;

O que buscamos?

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência com liderança e gestão de pessoas;
  • Vivência em varejo será considerado diferencial;

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Cesta básica
  • Auxílio combustível
  • Oportunidade de crescimento

Nossos valores

A Argenta destaca-se por valores fortes que construíram e mantêm a sua cultura:

  • Ambiente agradável: pessoas felizes em um ambiente limpo e agradável.
  • Confiança: faça o correto sempre.
  • Cuidar das pessoas: dignidade, respeito e oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Inovar sempre: fazer mais com menos, inovando sempre juntos.
  • Paixão por servir: aqui tem oportunidades para quem quer encantar as pessoas.
  • Sentimento de dono: equipe que se realiza com as conquistas.
  • Simplificar: faça simples, seguindo as regras.

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Summary
Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.
Job Duties

  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • Less than 1 year
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care
  • 1 year Experience as a registered respiratory therapist.

description:
About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership,enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Marketing Innovations Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda's new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience:5+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data —preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance is a plus.
  • Data-Driven Approach:Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Are you looking for a challenging career? Are you adaptable, curious, and persistent to achieve great results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon's team is looking for New Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Your role will focus on contributing to new acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting and recruiting of new merchants who can bring their range of products, competitive pricing, and availability to Amazon. Key job responsibilities

  1. Identify, prospect, and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
  2. Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to meet or exceed quarterly targets
  3. Partner with new merchants, providing insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
  4. Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon's high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
  5. Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems to manage their catalog, inventory, and performance efficiently
  6. Understand your categories to spot trends, seasonal items, and competitive pricing to tailor your pitch and advice
  7. Track and report development results, analyze reports, and interpret data for your merchant portfolio
  8. Prioritize your time effectively to achieve targets in a KPI-driven environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's degree

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 6+ months of sales experience

Estamos com uma vaga de Consultor(a) de Vendas aberta! Este profissional irá atuar em nosso kiosk Shopping Del Rey Belo Horizonte - MG.
SOBRE A PANDORA
A Joalheria que Transforma Histórias em Joias!
Com sede em Copenhague, Dinamarca, a Pandora fabrica suas deslumbrantes joias em três instalações de artesanato na Tailândia, onde mestres artesãos dedicam-se a criar cada peça com perfeição, se destacando como a maior joalheria do mundo, famosa por seus icônicos braceletes e charms que permitem que você conte sua própria história. Além disso, suas coleções incluem anéis, brincos e colares, todos com designs exclusivos e elaborados à mão, utilizando apenas materiais de altíssima qualidade.
Inovadora e Sustentável!
A Pandora é pioneira no setor, sendo a primeira joalheria do mundo a utilizar produtos 100% reciclados. Com um compromisso firme com a sustentabilidade, cada peça não é apenas uma joia, mas uma celebração do estilo e da consciência ambiental.
Na PANDORA, somos guiados por quatro valores:
We Dream (Sonhamos), somos visionários e vamos além do óbvio. We Dare (Ousamos) perseguir ambições ousadas com coragem e rapidez. We Care (Cuidamos) nós nos preocupamos profundamente uns com os outros, com nossos clientes e com o planeta que todos compartilhamos. Todos os dias nos esforçamos para ser um local de trabalho gratificante, onde cada um de nós pode prosperar e contribuir, onde os talentos podem crescer e cumprimos nossas promessas a colegas, clientes, parceiros e partes interessadas - We Deliver (entregamos).
Somos todos embaixadores de nossa marca e, juntos, formamos a comunidade Pandora.

title: Senior Solution Consultant/Advisor - BRAZIL ONLY
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.

Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.

Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of Sr Solution Consultant/Advisor to Coupa:

This role at Coupa will specialize in Procure-to-Invoice (P2I) product deployments, guiding global enterprises in designing and adopting best-in-class purchasing and invoicing processes. The role involves defining procurement strategies, leading functional design aspects, and ensuring successful, on-time implementations while maximizing Suite Synergy opportunities. As a trusted advisor, you will mentor solution architects, provide industry best practices, and strengthen relationships with customers and partners. Additionally, you will contribute to improving implementation frameworks and best practices.

What you'll do:

  • As a specialist in Procure-to-Invoice (P2I) product deployments, your main responsibilities will be in enabling customers in designing, configuring and adopting best-in-class purchasing and invoicing processes.
  • You will work with some of the largest companies in the world to guide them in defining the processes they use to manage their Procurement activities.
  • Help customers focus on their goals and drive the implementation solution architecture towards a successful, on-time implementation, taking into consideration Suite Synergy opportunities.
  • Oversee all functional design aspects of implementation by taking the lead in managing and mentoring workstream solution architects from both Coupa and partner teams, ensuring a successful delivery of the project scope.
  • Forge strong relationships with customers, partners, and colleagues.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and industry best practices to colleagues, partners and customers.
  • Create and/or improve implementation templates, best practices, training and presentations and be a champion for their adoption.
  • Manage customers where up to 25% of your time may include travel.
What you will bring to Coupa:

  • 6+ years’ consulting experience in Procure-to-Invoice, either as part of a procurement organization or a consulting firm or software provider (SAP Ariba, Basware, Ivalua, GEP).
  • Candidates should have extremely strong client management skills and be able to guide customers through best practice-driven design processes that lead towards a rapid, successful go live.
  • Experience with Inventory Management, Expenses Management and/or Spend Analytics is a plus.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A proven track record in prototyping, demonstrating, designing, configuring, and delivering procurement systems is required.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translating them into application and operational requirements.
  • Self-starter and quick learner, must be able to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and adapt to changes in a fast paced and passionate environment.
  • Highly organized with the ability/experience to manage multiple simultaneous Enterprise projects.
  • May require some flexibility in working hours due to Americas’ time zones.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Sales Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Sr. Sales Engineer role at Tenstorrent

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists has developed a high-performance RISC-V CPU from scratch and shares a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

As a Sr. Sales Engineer , you will collaborate closely with the sales team and customers, leveraging your deep technical knowledge in AI to drive the adoption of our products and solutions. You will be responsible for articulating the technical value of our offerings, conducting product demos, and addressing customer technical requirements. This is a customer-facing role that requires both technical expertise and excellent communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara, CA; Austin, TX; Boston, MA; or Toronto, ON.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Responsibilities

  1. Pre-sales Support: Partner with the sales team to understand customer needs, tailor solutions, and deliver technical presentations that clearly explain the capabilities and benefits of our AI solutions.
  2. Customer Engagement: Engage directly with customers in meetings, presentations, and workshops to understand their technical challenges and provide effective solutions.
  3. Technical Consultation: Provide technical guidance and support during the sales cycle, ensuring that proposed solutions meet customer requirements and align with their business objectives.
  4. Solution Design: Assist customers in defining and designing AI-driven solutions that integrate seamlessly with their existing systems and workflows.
  5. Documentation & Reporting: Prepare technical documentation, including solution architectures, technical proposals, and requirements gathering reports.
  6. Collaboration: Work closely with the customer success engineering, sales operations, and product teams to provide feedback from customers and help shape future product enhancements.

Experience & Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  2. Strong customer-facing skills with 10+ years of relevant technical, customer-facing experience (such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Account Manager).
  3. Strong proficiency in programming languages, particularly Python.
  4. Proven expertise in AI technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and/or computer vision.
  5. Understanding of AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, with expertise in Generative AI and LLM applications preferred.
  6. Experience selling AI and/or general purpose compute Hardware or Silicon IP.
  7. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  8. Passion for innovation and a proactive attitude towards learning and adopting new technologies.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background, and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

Due to U.S. Export Control laws and regulations, Tenstorrent is required to ensure compliance with licensing regulations when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries that have been licensing conditions set by the U.S. government.

Our engineering positions and certain engineering support positions require access to information, systems, or technologies that are subject to U.S. Export Control laws and regulations. Citizenship/permanent residency, asylee, and refugee information and/or documentation will be required and considered as Tenstorrent moves through the employment process.

If a U.S. export license is required, employment will not begin until a license with acceptable conditions is granted by the U.S. government. If a U.S. export license with acceptable conditions is not granted, then the offer of employment will be rescinded.

  • Formação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em atendimento no setor financeiro (PF, PJ, Agro).
  • Certificação ANBIMA CPA10 ou CPA20.
  • Conhecimento de produtos financeiros e habilidades de comunicação clara.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia, orientação ao cliente, facilitação e educação financeira.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, along with industry leaders across sectors. With a founder-led, profitable, and growing company, we employ over 1200 colleagues across 75+ countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet 2-4 times a year globally to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer for our Information Systems (IS) team. This role offers an opportunity for an automation-focused senior technologist passionate about Linux to build a career with Canonical and support those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. Experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology are essential.

Job Summary

The IS team maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, supporting over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops engineer, you will drive operations automation in private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers on product operation at scale, contribute to bug fixes and pull requests, and collaborate across teams. You will join a global team of SREs committed to delivering excellent services to our company, customers, and the Ubuntu Community.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation development and Gitops practices as an embedded tech lead
  • Collaborate with IS architects to align solutions with architecture vision
  • Design services as products for internal use
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements
  • Automate software operations for reusability and consistency across clouds
  • Maintain responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance skills, using observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch
  • Support and collaborate with globally distributed teams
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and teamwork
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly

Qualifications

  • Experience with infrastructure as code across private and public clouds
  • Product mindset focused on developing products, not just solutions
  • Proficiency in Python with large projects
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems
  • Managing and deploying cloud infrastructure via code
  • Knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases
  • Hands-on Linux server administration experience
  • Understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field
  • Effective communication skills in English (email, chat, video, in-person)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web
  • Quick learner with flexibility and adaptability
  • Interest in fast-changing environments and open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review and performance rewards
  • Comprehensive benefits including leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source innovation. As the publisher of Ubuntu, we impact AI, IoT, and cloud platforms globally. We value excellence, diversity, and a discrimination-free workplace. Working remotely since 2004, we foster a forward-thinking, inclusive environment.

Additional Details

  • Senior level: Mid-Senior

title: HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR
description:
HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon logistics warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve managing the mobilization/demobilization of workforce in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to manager levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, operational vacancy fill rates), indirect coordination of chartered transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

A day in the life
As an HRBP of a "Fulfillment Center - FC", no two days are alike, but a typical day will likely include the following responsibilities:

  1. Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  2. Lead the reporting and analysis of Human Resources metrics and goals ("attendance", "attrition", "fill-rate", delving into root cause analyses and improvement plans).
  3. Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  4. Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of mobilization and demobilization of personnel contingent.
  5. Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes, as well as the work environment and people's needs, on the "shop-floor".
  6. Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  7. Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  8. Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  9. Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  10. Serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns.
  11. Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  12. Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  13. Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  14. Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.

About the team
We could be a great match if you:
  • Are excited to work in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Completed Bachelors Degree
Experience in generalist Human Resources subsystems.
Experience in supporting massive and operational customer groups (factories, warehouses, call centers, etc).
Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (reads and writes easily and fluently, understands ~85% when listening and can provide quick and objective answers).
Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel at an intermediate level (VLOOKUP and pivot tables); BI tools will be a differential.
Must be willing to work 100% on-site at the FC in São João de Meriti-RJ, with flexibility in hours and days, especially during peak periods or promotions (Prime Day, Black Friday).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in HR for factory/manufacturing, transportation company, distribution center, or logistics.
Masters Degree

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Estaremos presencialmente no Espírito Santo para nosso processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

  • Bate papo com o time de Expansão;

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP Vitória ! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

We’re looking for our next Senior Cloud Data Platform Engineer. Could It Be You?

The Questrade Technology Group (QTG) is home to a unique environment, where our culture thrives and most importantly, we get stuff done! Questrade is continuing with its digital transformation initiative and our infrastructure footprint is growing beyond our data centres and into the Google Cloud Platform. We are currently working towards our exciting strategy that is driven by business value. Join us and help solve some complex challenges such as handling low latency and high traffic market data, event streams and messaging, in a hybrid cloud environment within an industry that has so much room for disruption.

The Cloud Data Platform Engineer will work with a primary focus on delivering Questrade’s Data Platform footprint, as an expansion of our cloud presence, enabling key initiatives such as our Digital Banking. This role will be working with several teams in the organization in a collaborative manner, helping deliver data related components that enable productivity across QTG by leveraging automation to deliver self-service components as much as possible. This key individual will be part of a team that drives the implementation of data components such as pipelines, applications, sanitation, supporting our data scientists and working with the rest of the product teams while collaborating with the architecture team, influencing the design and delivery of our data footprint and striving for greater functionality in our data systems.

Our Cloud Data Platform Engineer needs to be able to gather and understand engineering requirements, provide a solution, and work in the team to achieve high quality features. This Engineer will need a passion for complex problems, and enjoy the challenge of operating complex and mission critical systems under extreme loads. Do you think you are up to the challenge?   • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform

Summary
Performs CT scans of designated anatomy using professional judgment while imaging with regard to technical quality according to physician specifications. Provides courteous and professional delivery of CT technical exams and procedures while adhering to radiation safety precautions. Supports patient questions and concerns regarding exam procedures and process, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality regarding PHI and HIPPA related information. On-call as required by the department. Works in a hospital facility that offers full hospital services. Provides direct patient care to high acuity patients encompassing emergency, inpatient and outpatient classes supporting up to and including trauma and ICU.
Job Duties

  • Performs all types of imaging procedures and operates all equipment safely and properly including scanners, injectors, and monitors.
  • Reviews all images of all exams, repeating images as necessary for best possible result.
  • Communicates with the patient by addressing the patient by name, introducing self to the patient, explaining the exam in lay terms and keeping the patient Informed of exam progress.
  • Prepares patient images to PACs for interpretation by a radiologist and administers contrast media per protocol.
  • Completes technical notes, verifies images, and sends exams to PACS promptly.
  • Notifies physician of any adverse reaction to contrast media or change in patient's condition.
  • Reviews patient chart/script prior to initiating exam to verify pertinent information.
  • Prepares patients for CT procedures by accurately assessing patient’s needs, medical history, and provides patient education.
  • Operates computed tomography scanner for data acquisition, reconstruction of images, documentation of images, and performs quality control measures for the purpose of ensuring optimal quality images.
  • Attends department meetings or other mandatory meetings with a positive attitude.
  • Practices accurate and timely completion of scheduled and unscheduled work to maximize productivity.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Technical School Diploma Graduate of accredited Radiography program or equivalent or
  • CNMT, RT(CT) Certified
  • Less than 1 year experience as a Radiologic Technologist
  • Ability to provide proper patient care essential to radiologic procedures.
  • Knowledge and skills to perform scans on patients of all ages, adapting to various protocols.
  • Proficient use of the advanced software for CT scanning and post procedure processing applications.
  • Strong aptitude for CT technology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and upbeat demeanor.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • RT - Registered Technologist Radiology - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire or
  • CNMT - Certified Nuclear Med Tech NMTCB - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
  • CT - Computed Tomography ARRT - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate of Health Science program
  • Knowledge and skills to perform venipuncture.
Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Data Engineer - FinTech, Brazil Application
description:
Data Engineer - FinTech, Brazil Application

Are you passionate about data? Does the prospect of dealing with massive volumes of data excite you? Do you want to build data engineering solutions that process billions of records a day in a scalable fashion using Amazon Web Services technologies? Do you want to create the next-generation tools for intuitive data access?
Amazon's Finance Technology team is seeking truly innovative Data Engineer to join the team that is shaping the future of the finance data platform. The team is committed to building big data platforms that support Amazon's rapidly growing and dynamic businesses, and use it to deliver the BI applications which will have an immediate influence on day-to-day decision making. Amazon has culture of data-driven decision-making, and demands data that is timely, accurate, and actionable. Our platform serves Amazon's finance, tax and accounting functions across the globe.
As a Data Engineer, you should be an expert with data warehousing technical components (e.g. Data Modeling, ETL and Reporting), infrastructure (e.g. hardware and software) and their integration. You should have deep understanding of the architecture for enterprise level data warehouse solutions using multiple platforms (RDBMS, Columnar, Cloud). You should be an expert in the design, creation, management, and business use of large datasets. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions. The individual is expected to be able to build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable ETL and reporting solutions. You should be enthusiastic about learning new technologies and be able to implement solutions using them to provide new functionality to the users or to scale the existing platform. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required as the person will work very closely with diverse teams. Having strong analytical skills is a plus. Above all, you should be passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions and drive change.
Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, relishes working with large transactional volumes and big data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts (that are typically being defined in real-time), and, above all, is a passionate about data and analytics. In this role you will be part of a team of engineers to create world's largest financial data warehouses and BI tools for Amazon's expanding global footprint.
Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and support a platform providing secured access to large datasets.
- Interface with tax, finance and accounting customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete BI solutions.
- Model data and metadata to support ad-hoc and pre-built reporting.
- Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions.
- Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
- Tune application and query performance using profiling tools and SQL.
- Analyze and solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
- Learn and understand a broad range of Amazon’s data resources and know when, how, and which to use and which not to use.
- Keep up to date with advances in big data technologies and run pilots to design the data architecture to scale with the increased data volume using AWS.
- Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for datasets.
- Triage many possible courses of action in a high-ambiguity environment, making use of both quantitative analysis and business judgment.

Key job responsibilities
A Data Engineer II is an autonomous contributor who uses a broad set of design approaches to pragmatically solve difficult problems delivering high quality, stable and performant code. They use their expertise in team’s infrastructure and data products like Synchro, Oracle EBS, FGBSBI to provide technical direction to tax users, works with Tax Tech to understand the business requirements, defines physical and logical data model, designs the solution and contributes great amount to the code base, and guides other engineers on the same team as well as from other teams. They review their design with senior engineers to ensure data engineering best practices are followed. They insist on high standards and set an example with his code, design and implementation decisions. They lead the way in adopting native AWS technologies and implementing new trends in data engineering space. They continuously focus on operational excellence, constructively identify problems and propose solutions to fix them for good.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

Sobre a Dynamox:

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva em ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva que ontem.

Além disso, temos orgulho em possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, buscamos promover a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente.

Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site .

A equipe tem parceria direta com as demais equipes de desenvolvimento de software e pesquisa e inovação, visando evolução e desenvolvimento do produto.

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software de forma colaborativa com versionamento em Git;

About Unlimit

Founded in 2009, Unlimit is a global fintech company that offers a large portfolio of financial services, including payment processing, banking as a service (BaaS), and an on&off-ramp fiat solution for crypto, DeFi, and GameFi. The company’s mission is to deliver solutions that eliminate financial borders, enabling businesses to operate both locally and internationally across Europe, the UK, LATAM, APAC, India, and Africa. Unlimit has 700 employees across 16 offices and five continents, including London, Singapore, São Paulo, Hong Kong, and Mexico. For further information, please visit: .

Job purpose

The Underwriting analyst will review and complete underwriting and credit analysis of applications by applying sound underwriting judgment and adhering to company policy. You will be responsible for reviewing potential and existing merchants from a risk, regulatory, and compliance perspective. Part of this role also involves facilitating the company’s growth by scaling internal processes and focusing on continuous optimization and automation.

Main duties and responsibilities

  1. Ensure adherence to Company and Card Schemes rules and policies.
  2. Follow underwriting standards, instructions, and best practices to minimize risk and maximize efficiency.
  3. Perform underwriting and risk assessment, including credit risks, of new and existing customers.
  4. Calculate financial risk exposure and implement relevant risk mitigation measures.
  5. Set up processes, monitor, and execute checks related to merchant onboarding and monitoring.
  6. Evaluate and refine existing procedures to optimize merchant onboarding and monitoring processes.
  7. Provide advice and support to internal stakeholders regarding merchant onboarding questions.
  8. Support periodic reviews and audits.
  9. Engage in continuous process improvement and share best practices.

Main qualifications, skills, and experience

  1. At least 3 years of experience in acquiring and underwriting merchants.
  2. Understanding of AML, KYC, PCI, and Internal Controls.
  3. Knowledge of Card Schemes rules and regulations concerning merchant onboarding and monitoring.
  4. Solid practical knowledge of credit risk assessment.
  5. Extremely detail-oriented, organized, and capable of multitasking.
  6. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, sharing ideas to improve teamwork.
  7. Proactive, owning, and willing to challenge the status quo.
  8. Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  9. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English required.
  10. Strong analytical skills to identify potential fraud and compliance issues.
  11. Proven skills in risk assessment with appropriate escalation when needed.

We offer

  1. Attractive monthly salary commensurate with experience.
  2. Modern workplace with all necessary equipment based in São Paulo, Brazil.
  3. Opportunity to learn from a team of top international professionals.

Job Description

    Req#: 1061874

    A triagem para o processo seletivo é realizada através da leitura do seu currículo anexado, caso já esteja anexado, lembre-se de manter o arquivo atualizado. Manter o currículo atualizado aumenta as suas chances de sucesso no processo seletivo.

    Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

    A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

    Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

    O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

    Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

    A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

    Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

    Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

    Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

    Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

    N° de Vagas: 01

    Formação: Graduação em Engenharia Civil ou Engenharia de Produção Civil .

    Localidade: Nova Lima/ MG - Disponibilidade/Mobilidade para acompanhar obras em municípios ao longo da Estrada de Ferro Vitória-Minas.

    Horário de Trabalho: 08h as 17h

    Tipo de contrato: Indeterminado

    Período de inscrição: de 21/06/2023 a 27/06/2023

    Como profissional, você vai fazer...

    • Acompanhamento de obras civis de infraestrutura urbana.
    • Gestão e controle de KPIs das obras em andamento.
    • Apoio direto à equipe de implantação nos processos de construção, dando todo o input necessário para garantir o ritmo das atividades e cumprimento dos prazos.
    • Analisar documentação das contratadas para retroalimentação dos cronogramas e documentações de gestão interna, bem como identificar falhas de planejamento e gestão de riscos de atrasos configurados com históricos de produção e tendências de finalização.
    • Implementação de ferramentas de gestão ágil, juntamente à equipe de construção, visando garantir o controle das atividades planejadas.
    • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, ferramentas de controle.
    • Apoio nos processos de contratação.
    • Participação em reuniões de contratadas.

    Estamos muito felizes por ter alguém como você:

    O que precisamos que você tenha obrigatoriamente :

    • Conhecimento em ferramentas de planejamento (Primavera P6, Microsoft Projetc).
    • Experiência consolidada em gestão de implantação de obras, controle e gestão de KPIs e índices de produção das contratadas.
    • Capacidade de análise de riscos de planejamento, diante do histórico e tendência de cada obra.
    • Disponibilidade/Mobilidade para acompanhar obras em municípios ao longo da Estrada de Ferro Vitória-Minas.

    O que desejamos que você apresente:

    • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos.
    • Conhecimento em Power BI.

    Como é trabalhar na Vale?

    Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

    Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

    Solicitamos aos trabalhadores que se vacinem contra a COVID-19 e que apresentem o cartão de vacinação com os dados do imunizante, ou carteira de vacinação digital gerada pelo Conecte SUS.

title: Junior In-Play Trader
description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Let's start with the role

This role is an opportunity to learn how the odds evolve during a game. The In-play Trading team is responsible for covering all live in-play events and plays a crucial role in shaping our customer experience.

An In-play trader manages events from a wide range of sports, including football, basketball, tennis but also general sports such as volleyball, ice-hockey, beach volleyball etc. They even offer special markets in many of them, surpassing those by other operators. This position demands concentration and observation, combined with a mathematical background, in order to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for our users.

The role requires a flexible working schedule to cover the busy sporting calendar (weekends, evenings etc.)

As an In Play Trader you will:

  • Monitor real - time sports events and perform live trading;
  • Supervise and adjust data with the aim of providing precise and competitive live odds;
  • Provide accurate and rapid resulting for any event of a variety of sports;
  • Use both external providers and in-house odds to optimize/customize our offerings and performance;
  • Evaluate events according to their potential demand, to offer the widest and the most competitive offer market wise;.
  • Continuously monitor bet placements, assess live events risks and take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate risks;
  • Ensure that customers have access to the most up-to-date and competitive odds, enhancing the overall betting experience;
  • Maintain effective communication within the trading team and with external stakeholders to ensure a unified and coordinated approach.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g statistics, mathematics,finance)
  • Strong interest in sports with a good understanding of various sports and betting markets;
  • Proven analytical and mathematical skills;
  • Betting/sportsbook playing experience/activity;
  • Be able to make quick, well-informed decisions and work within tight deadlines;
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills;
  • Multitasking abilities and PC literacy;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Willingness to work flexible hours in line with the business and sports calendar requirements.

description:
Signify, the new company name of Philips Lighting, is the global leader in lighting building on 125+ years of innovations.


Our purpose is to unlock the extraordinary potential of light for brighter lives and a better world.


We are proud to be ahead of the game in the Internet of Things and on track to be carbon neutral by 2020. Our Philips products, Interact connected lighting systems, and data-enabled services transform people’s lives in homes, buildings, and public spaces.

We define the meaning of light…join us to #findyourmeaning @ Signify!

Key areas of responsibility for a Solution Engineer for Systems & Services :

  • Participates in new projects during installation, commissioning (remotely/ on-site) and acceptance testing as required or in support of System Center.
  • Prepare and deliver Engineering Documentation after System Start-up.
  • Provide relevant input to the Division for building blocks improvement.
  • Develops detailed design for the relevant programmable building blocks.
  • Supports Architecture Manager/ Proposal Manager/ Project Manager in the technical solution during proposal and services contract execution.
  • Reviews/ verifies the control design, schematics and drawings delivered by the Technical Designer.
  • Iterates the design of his own sub-system, until cost of the sub-system matches budget allocated.
  • Builds mock-ups to test inter-operability and/or features of the sub-system.
  • Provides technical expertise in sales presentations, product demonstrations, installation and maintenance.
  • Validates delivered solution ensuring all building blocks are functioning according to specifications and ensuring Lifecycle services capabilities.
  • Preparation of system testing and turnover documentation including scoped documents, test records, test procedures and other similar required documents.
  • Prepare detailed startup plans for assigned project system commissioning activities, integrate all discipline activities into these plans.
  • Prepare system turnover packages in accordance with project procedures by assembling and reviewing all system test documentation (all disciplines) for adequacy and completeness.
  • Monitor and control system performance and be accountable for performance of the system against the budget.
  • Participate in system turnover walkdowns for both Construction and Customer; initiate, track and resolve punch-list items for assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Enhances design with key points included by proposal manager in the consolidated proposal.
  • Develops, trains and deploys user instruction/ manuals to customer organization during handover.
  • Works with all Stakeholders in the creation of quotes for architectures selected, system additions and upgrades.
  • Drives for high levels of customer satisfaction by ensuring timely and correct execution of service obligations in accordance with the contracts (warranty and Service) and/or solving of complaints, inquiries and requests about technical products.
  • Analyses and solves application failures, complaints (on or offsite), supports upgrades, drives root cause analysis and preventive action. Keeps customers proactively informed.
  • Drives feedback loops towards Systems & Service Centers / Divisions.
  • Fulfills documentations for service-related issues and resolutions and / or keeps complaint database up to date.
  • Proposes additional services as required through maintaining intimate customer relationship.
  • Provides special / custom training to customers upon request.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed in Electrical, Electronic, Automation, or Mechatronic Engineering.

  • Solid knowledge in specification and documentation of design patterns within own engineering domain.

  • Familiar with industry-standard work processes for system testing and commissioning.

  • Proven experience in managing suppliers and subcontractors effectively.

  • Fluent in Spanish (mandatory); English proficiency is highly desirable.

  • Willing and available to travel up to 50%.

*This is an on-site position.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

    A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

In this role, you will

  • Directly contribute code and be a code owner for multiple services and code bases
  • Collaborate with the Fortnite, Unreal Engine, and Epic Games Store teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate
  • Work with internal and external UEFN development teams, including well-known brands, to address concerns about asset integrity and information disclosure
  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)

  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

description:
ENGENHEIRO MASTER – MINERAÇÃO – VAGA PREFERENCIAL PARA MULHERES

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

Formação: Engenheiro de Minas

Localidade: Parauapebas/PA

Horário de Trabalho: 8h às 17h

Período de inscrição: de 28/09/2022 a 05/10/2022

Como profissional, você vai...

  • Elaborar modelo matemático para os projetos de geração de valor das minas.

  • Analisar e validar as premissas para a elaboração do modelo de reservas e das cavas finais.
  • Gerar declaração de recursos.
  • Gerar declaração de reserva.
  • Definir cavas finais (modelo matemático).

  • Buscar oportunidades de atendimento em conjunto com o COI Corredor para atendimento dos objetivos de produção.
  • Validar os planos de mina definidos para os ciclos estratégico e orçamentário;
  • Assegurar a programação das atividades de conservação e desenvolvimento de infraestrutura da mina de acordo com diretrizes dos planos (drenagem, vias de acesso, projetos de cava e pilha, etc).
  • Garantir os alinhamentos e a interface com a áreas operacional e com as geotecnia para desdobrar o programa operacional (plano de chuvas, plano DBG).
  • Selecionar e dimensionar e equipamentos de infraestrutura de mina.
  • Atuar como suporte técnico às áreas operacionais e demais horizontes de planejamento de lavra, conforme solicitado.

Estamos muito felizes por ter alguém como você:

Pré requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência no planejamento e gestão de projetos de geração de valor.
  • Otimização de Cava e sequenciamento LOM.
  • Profundo conhecimento de gerenciamento e análise de banco de dados.
  • Visão sistêmica do planejamento de mina em todos os horizontes.
  • Domínio das técnicas de otimização e design de cava, pilha e infraestrutura de mina.
  • Conhecimento das geociências (geologia, geotecnia, hidrogeologia, processamento; etc.).

  • Domínio de soluções de programação de atividades e alocação de equipamentos (Lineup).

  • Dimensionamento de capacidade operacional e impactos da manutenção (DF, MMTR, MTBF, etc.) e de operação (produtividade, UF, etc.).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Pré requisitos desejáveis:

  • Viabilidade Econômica de Projetos.
  • Conhecimentos em Direito Minerário.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

description:
Join to apply for the Public Cloud Project Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer in global distributed collaboration, with over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet in person a few times a year in interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Public Cloud Project Manager . This role requires customer relationship management and advocacy for Canonical's technical assets. It offers an opportunity for a technologist passionate about Linux and Project Management to develop a career with Canonical. Ideal candidates will have an affinity for software, excellent communication skills, and a passion for technology, working alongside some of the industry's best at Canonical.

The role involves providing account leadership and insight for Canonical's key Tier 1 Enterprise Public Cloud accounts, collaborating with individuals from Software Engineering to Senior Executives. You will manage multiple high-profile projects simultaneously, shaping Statements of Work or similar agreements, managing project lifecycles, and ensuring goals for both Canonical and clients are met. Periodic international travel is required, with travel details varying based on company and program needs.

Location: This role is remote within the Americas region.

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and resources.
  • Identifying and mitigating technical and project risks and issues.
  • Maintaining strong customer focus and collaborating with stakeholders for successful outcomes.
  • Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with clients.
  • Managing delivery schedules of third-party deliverables.
  • Managing cross-organization engineering requests outside existing contracts.
  • Advocating Canonical's technologies to customers.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in IT Cloud, software development project management, or similar roles.
  • Deep understanding of Linux, open source, and the public cloud space.
  • Software engineering experience.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience leading remote, cross-cultural teams and clients.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field.
  • Project Management Certification (e.g., PMP).
  • Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., Scrum Master).
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

What we offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and performance bonuses.
  • Additional benefits including leave, parental leave, wellness programs, travel opportunities, and more.

About Canonical:

Canonical is a pioneering open-source tech firm, publisher of Ubuntu, and a leader in AI, IoT, and cloud platforms. We recruit globally, uphold high standards, and promote a diverse, inclusive workplace. Most colleagues work remotely, reflecting our future-focused approach.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer . We value diversity and provide fair consideration to all applicants regardless of background or identity.

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology.   • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Who We Are
