As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Job Description

Your Career

The Senior Director Technical Services - LATAM is a key member of the Palo Alto Networks Technical Services Leadership Team, responsible for leading the post-sales technical services organization in the Latin America (LATAM) region. This role focuses on driving exceptional customer outcomes, ensuring value realization, and fostering operational excellence.

This leader will collaborate closely with sales peers in LATAM to align technical services strategies with regional business objectives and customer needs. They will lead a team of technical experts, focusing on the deployment and adoption of Palo Alto Networks solutions, with a specific emphasis on Prisma Access Browser. This high-visibility, high-impact role reports directly to the VP of Global Technical Services and requires a strategic thinker, exceptional leader, and strong collaborator who thrives in a dynamic environment.

Your Impact

  • Lead the LATAM region's post-sales Technical Services team, focusing on rapid and reliable deployments and customer value realization, tailored to the unique needs of the LATAM market.

  • Collaborate closely with LATAM sales leadership to align technical services strategies with regional sales goals, customer requirements, and market dynamics.

  • Drive initiatives to optimize workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and ensure operational efficiency specifically within the LATAM region, including improving deployment times, resource utilization, and the accuracy of delivery forecasts.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with LATAM customers and executive-level leadership to gain insights and feedback on improving the post-sales experience and ensure customer satisfaction. Lead in critical customer situations within the LATAM region.

  • Tailor the delivery of the global Prisma Access Browser (PAB) deployment team to the specific requirements and nuances of the LATAM market.

  • Build a strong cross-functional interlock and operating cadence with LATAM Sales, Center of Excellence, Product Management, and Technology teams to improve product delivery methodologies, inform product quality, and drive continuous improvement in the region.

  • Own and drive the overall technical services delivery experience for LATAM customers; measure, monitor, and report overall customer outcomes, satisfaction, and drive programs to assure continuous improvement within the LATAM organization and across the customer base in the region.

What You Bring

  • Deep understanding of the LATAM market dynamics and customer expectations.

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholder groups like sales, product development and support teams to drive customer success and achieve regional business objectives.

  • Thought leadership and the ability to anticipate and quickly adapt to changing customer and company needs.

  • Passion for creating diverse teams and a customer obsessed, outcomes focused culture. Ability to inspire and attract the best talent.

  • Ability to create a strategy and align resources to execute. Focus on the long term mission and the ability to create initiatives that scale and solve the big problem that impacts many customers and sets the company up for success.

  • Executive presence; The ability to effectively communicate and influence at every level within the organization and with customers

  • Strategic mindset, ability to scale, strong operational, analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of making major transformational improvements to customer, operational and financial performance.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience leading post sales technical services teams within the LATAM region, including managing diverse, multi-lingual, and multi-cultural teams.

  • Strong understanding of the specific cybersecurity challenges and opportunities in the LATAM market.

  • 15+ years’ experience in a high growth SaaS/Cloud Enterprise Technical Services Organization, or similar experience. Including at least 3+ years in a Director leadership capacity leading worldwide teams.

  • Strong technical background with expertise in cybersecurity domains such as network security and cloud security

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with sales, product, and engineering teams

  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to lead and inspire diverse, global teams

  • Demonstrated experience leading global direct/indirect teams of +100 across multiple languages and cultures

  • Demonstrated experience in process optimization, automation, and leveraging technology to enhance technical deployment.

  • Strong business acumen with experience in managing budgets, resources, and P&L responsibilities

  • Prior experience managing networking or enterprise security product services

  • Estimated travel 30%

  • STEM Bachelor’s Degree required or equivalent experience. Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.

  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical needs.

  3. Advocate for and manage funding, including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.

  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’s data landscape.

  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams, leveraging knowledge of both Mondelez business domains and technical expertise.

  7. Think strategically, connecting stakeholder use cases to technology solutions and considering the end-to-end experience.

  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen while proactively managing ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify and execute opportunities leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics, including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.

  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems such as SAP, SAC, and Hyperion is a plus.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgment in all decisions and interactions, aligned with our values, policies, and external regulations.

More about this role

We recognize our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, prioritizing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to break stereotypes and barriers to ensure societal representation within our company. Our Diversity Committee operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, and we are part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. Using a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen, you will help Mondelez’s Finance organization build data and analytics products aimed at an AI-ready future. Your products will serve decision-makers at the highest levels, improving measurement and insight through Mondelez’s data. As demand for data and insights grows within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insights to teams that need them.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  • Management consulting experience is a plus.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  • Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

  • Limited travel up to 20% of the time.

Mondelez International values the well-being of our people and offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid models with remote work options on certain days.

No relocation support is available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We produce, sell, and distribute beloved brands such as Oreo, Lacta, Trident, and many more, in Brazil. Our products are available in over 700,000 points of sale and in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão and Curitiba, and we operate one of the company's 11 global technology centers, dedicated to R&D.

Mondelez International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos uma pessoa ambiciosa e motivada para se unir ao nosso time comercial no segmento de Construção Civil, a qual durante os meses iniciais trabalhará com foco em entender o negócio, estratégia, organização, tipos de clientes, modelo de vendas e outros tópicos, com o objetivo de ser preparada para gerenciar sua própria carteira de clientes por meio de vendas consultivas, desenvolvimento de contas e novos negócios.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Dentro desta função, suas funções durante os primeiros meses serão focadas no processo de treinamento e acompanhamento da área de vendas de campo. Com o apoio da equipe de vendas da Hilti, você se dedicará a:

  1. Entender como funciona a execução disciplinada e o desenvolvimento de negócios na Hilti
  2. Suporte na identificação e proposição de novas oportunidades de negócios
  3. Participar de discussões sobre as estratégias de negociação das contas, cobrindo as dimensões importantes e mais relevantes
  4. Atuar de forma colaborativa com os membros da equipe nos projetos e atividades que lhe são atribuídas
  5. Visitar clientes dentro das áreas, rotas e itinerários designados. Você poderá estar no canteiro de obras, em fábricas ou em escritórios
  6. Fazer parte da execução das vendas dos produtos, incluindo demonstrações nos canteiros de obras de alguns dos produtos mais inovadores do setor, acompanhados de softwares e serviços pós-venda que fazem parte da marca Hilti

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Graduação Superior Completa em Engenharia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para outra cidade/estado a médio prazo
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado desejável, porém, não excludente
  • Experiência prévia em vendas e gestão de carteira de clientes será um diferencial

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes, e em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

title: Data Engineer, Corporate Data
description:
At DoorDash, people are our most important asset. We build the capability to help our leaders make more informed decisions on identifying, attracting, developing, and retaining talent. We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help us scale our analytics alongside DoorDash’s enormous growth. Come build, experiment, and grow while shaping a best-in-class data team at DoorDash.

About the Role

DoorDash is seeking an experienced data engineer to join our People Analytics team. We’re a data-driven organization, empowering local economies and our people to do the best work of their careers. This role will get in on the ground floor helping to build and support the data infrastructure powering our data-driven insights to attract, develop, and retain the best talent to power and grow DoorDash. You will support and scale our people reporting and analytics within the People Team. In this role, you will partner with a team of analysts, scientists, and engineers to develop the tools and insights for our people and decision-makers. Come help us enable our business to garner insights and be a builder, engineer, consultant, and security/privacy advocate.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Architect and engineer our data infrastructure for People data
  • Design and implement data warehouse schemas, tables, and views to provide a source of true datasets
  • Develop ETL pipelines using tools such as Airflow and dbt for data profiling, cleaning, and transformation
  • Support self-service analytics projects by creating secure data structures
  • Provide underlying data support for all People metrics (recruiting pipelines, attrition, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, compensation and benefits, etc.)
  • Ensure data integrity across all People data
  • Rigorously document system requirements and configuration to build operational excellence
  • Understand and identify opportunities to improve, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Train peers on new processes and functionality as needed
  • Help build data governance with a single source of truth

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of industry experience in data engineering or software engineering
  • Experience deploying cloud architecture like dbt, Airflow, and Databricks in AWS
  • Expert SQL skills and experience writing complex queries
  • Proficiency authoring Airflow DAGs
  • Experience with data observability and monitoring frameworks
  • Strong business thinker, able to use ‘first principles’ to solve challenging business problems at their root level
  • Data-driven, able to analyze data with strong attention to detail and accuracy, and passionate about telling the story behind the data hence turning the data into insight

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

  • We are a technologically and data-driven business
  • We are committed to our clients and connected through our vision of “Delivering Good”
  • We love solving problems, thinking creatively, and trying new things
  • We believe in autonomy & taking the initiative
  • We are challenged, developed, and have a meaningful impact
  • We take what we do seriously. We don’t take ourselves seriously
  • We have a smart, experienced leadership team that wants to do it right & is open to new ideas
  • We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits
  • You will be proud to say that you work for DoorDash and will know that the work you do brings joy to our clients every day

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: ANALISTA DE PRICING PLENO
description:
Responsável por elaborar análises, estratégias e políticas de precificação para produtos, considerando custos, margens, concorrência e posicionamento estratégico. Atua de forma analítica e consultiva, propondo soluções que garantam competitividade e rentabilidade à empresa.

Análise e Estruturação de Preços: Construir modelos de precificação baseados em custo (cost-plus), valor percebido e inteligência competitiva, realizar análises de margem bruta e líquida por produto, canal, cliente e região, determinar pontos de equilíbrio e ranges de preços por segmento de mercado.

Estudos de Elasticidade e Sensibilidade de Preço: Aplicar metodologias para estimar como variações nos preços impactam volume de vendas e margem, apoiar testes A/B de preços em determinados canais, clientes ou produtos.

Acompanhamento do Mercado e da Concorrência: Manter e atualizar base de preços da concorrência por meio de coletas diretas, bases públicas ou dados de distribuidores, avaliar movimentações de mercado (entrada de novos players, mudanças cambiais, incentivos tributários etc.).

Gestão de Tabelas de Preço e Descontos: Desenvolver, revisar e publicar listas de preços por canal (varejo, distribuidor, OEM, B2B), controlar políticas de desconto, bonificação, rebate e condições comerciais, validar solicitações de exceções de preços fora da política padrão.

Integração com Outras Áreas: Trabalhar de forma conjunta com time de Vendas, Controladoria, Finanças, Planejamento Comercial e Marketing, participar do planejamento orçamentário (pricing como componente estratégico de metas).

Governança e Compliance de Pricing: Assegurar que as decisões de precificação estejam documentadas e em conformidade com as diretrizes internas, criar processos para gestão de validade de preços e auditoria de condições comerciais.

Relatórios e Suporte à Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver dashboards com indicadores de desempenho de preços, margens e elasticidade,preparar apresentações para diretoria com análises estratégicas de pricing e recomendações.

Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs): % Margem de contribuição atingida vs. Planejada, índice de exceções fora da política de preços (% do faturamento), nível de acurácia das simulações de precificação, SLA de resposta para análises e simulações de preços, Taxa de sucesso em campanhas com reajuste de preço e redução de perdas por precificação incorreta.

Somos informais nas relações, valorizamos a inovação e atuamos em um ambiente descontraído, cada vez mais colaborativo e com intencionalidade no avanço da diversidade e inclusão. Se acordos? Também será uma pessoa que irá desenhar e medir os KPIs, discutindo constantemente junto com os tempos sobre o andamento das entregas, eventuais ajustes de rota e mudanças na estratégia, se necessário. title: Supply Chain Team Lead
description:
Job ID: 2921822 | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho e atua com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI.

A Amazon está procurando um Líder de Equipe AVS ISM para gerenciar uma equipe de gestores de estoque. Os Serviços para Fornecedores Amazon (AVS) são um conjunto de serviços projetados para ajudar os fornecedores mais estratégicos da Amazon a crescer e oferecer a melhor experiência ao cliente.

Como Líder de Equipe ISM para Serviços de Fornecedores Amazon, você será responsável por gerar impacto em um grande grupo de fornecedores através de uma equipe de ISMs que se reportará a você. Sua prioridade será cumprir nosso compromisso de ajudar os fornecedores a melhorar seu desempenho em métricas-chave do varejo, garantir sua satisfação com o serviço e melhorar continuamente a produtividade de sua equipe.

Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Fornecedores para entender as necessidades dos seus fornecedores e definir as metas e objetivos adequados. Você se reunirá regularmente com os Líderes de Categoria para obter orientação e ajudá-los na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Responsabilidades

  1. Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast);
  2. Definição de planos de ação conjunta com os parceiros para eliminar defeitos de Supply Chain e fazer revisões regulares de progresso com fornecedores;
  3. Cooperar e construir um relacionamento de confiança em todas as funções e níveis de trabalho dentro da organização do parceiro;
  4. Preparação de revisões regulares de progresso para implementar soluções sustentáveis;
  5. Organização e gestão de projetos com fornecedores sobre melhoria contínua/Kaizens;
  6. Desenvolvimento de projetos internos para desenvolver ainda mais o programa AVS.

Requisitos Mínimos

  1. Bacharel/Licenciatura (engenharia, administração ou áreas relacionadas à operações/cadeia de suprimento/logística);
  2. Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  3. Experiência em gestão de produto/categoria, logística, gestão da cadeia de suprimentos, planejamento comercial, consultoria ou áreas relacionadas;
  4. Capacidade de construir relacionamentos efetivos com parceiros-chave;
  5. Inglês avançado (escrito e verbal);
  6. Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes grupos funcionais.

Desejável:

  1. Experiência com SQL;
  2. Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);
  3. Experiência com Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen;
  4. Experiência com análise financeira.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Se você tem uma deficiência e precisa de uma acomodação no local de trabalho durante o processo de aplicação e contratação, incluindo suporte para a entrevista ou processo de integração, visite para mais informações.

Venha se tornar um CLICKER também!

O que faz um Consultor Comercial?
O Consultor Comercial é responsável por fortalecer o relacionamento com parceiros estratégicos, identificar novas oportunidades de negócio e apoiar o time de vendas nas ações comerciais.

Quais são suas DEMANDAS e RESPONSABILIDADES:
• Identificar e atrair novos parceiros estratégicos, com foco na ampliação da rede de atuação e fortalecimento da presença da marca em mercados potenciais;
• Apresentar e alinhar os parceiros aos produtos, processos comerciais e políticas de parceria, garantindo clareza e sinergia na atuação conjunta;
• Apoiar os parceiros no fechamento de oportunidades, fornecendo suporte técnico e comercial durante todas as etapas do funil de vendas;

• Organizar as prioridades e se planejar para fazer contato e agendar as reuniões com os leads qualificados, no início do dia ou sempre que tiver demandas;
• Acompanhar a experiência do lead no período de teste, realizando contatos pontuais, via telefone ou WhatsApp a fim de acompanhar os testes, sanar dúvidas e manter a temperatura do lead quente até o fechamento do negócio;
• Conduzir a negociação com o lead focando nos benefícios, na eficácia do sistema e na solução das necessidades da empresa, para iniciar o plano, formas de pagamentos e reverter possíveis objeções;
• Atender as chamadas receptivas esclarecendo dúvidas, qualificando o lead e direcionando-o ao consultor para corresponder às suas expectativas e necessidades.

Pré-requisitos:
• Residir em Belo Horizonte ou região metropolitana;
• Experiência com CRMs e funil de vendas;
• Vivência com canais de vendas (telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp), parcerias ou afiliados;
• Conhecimento em emissão de NFs;
• Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em ouvir e entender as necessidades dos parceiros e potencial cliente;
• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em um ambiente dinâmico;
• Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.

Escolaridade:

The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. Position Summary
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.
Role & Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Skills & Experience
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
The mission of the LXD team is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We are hiring a Golang software engineer to work on the low level Go codebase sitting between our REST API and the low level C libraries used to manage containers and virtual machines. We are looking for system-level developers with experience in design and data management/modeling.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Design, implement and document system level Go code
  • Model data, design database schema and implement data storage in a dqlite (SQL) database
  • Maintain code quality through static analysis, unit and system tests
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks/year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You have experience programming in Go and C
  • You are knowledgeable in networking and storage technologies
  • You have experience with two or more of: cloud computing, virtualisation, containers, distributed systems, open source community
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are enterprising, thoughtful and self-motivated
  • You have a bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Your Career

Palo Alto Networks is scaling its world-class strategy organization and looking for Team Manager in the area of security services. Though our security services are successful both in the market as well as at preventing attackers, the landscape is continually changing and in need of innovation leadership. The Palo Alto Networks Strategy function is a focused team that works on our most mission-critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth.

As a Manager, of the renewals Team, your efforts will directly impact the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top-of-mind for our executives, particularly as those relate to key partnerships having strategic value to the business. You will lead initiatives with stakeholders to formulate mutually beneficial and measurable outcomes for technical and business objectives with strategic partners. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, influencing skills and ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Manage the overall day to day renewal operations of assigned direct reportsand districts / regions in the LATAM regions
  • Motivate your direct reports to drive pipeline development and revenues through renewal sales efforts leveraging the partner network
  • Ability to accurately forecast to leadership teams and drive a committed number on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis to SR. Manager and VP
  • Coaching and development of subordinates, bi-weekly 121's
  • Supervise and assist direct reports on large deals through to completion
  • Evaluate, and document, yourdirect reports based on Key Metrics and goals set by Leadership
  • Monitor the outbound efforts of assigned you renewals reps by tracking and reporting weekly activities
  • Collaborate with Sales Leaders to identify strategies to achieve sales goals and uncover new, high value opportunities alongside renewals
  • Provide accurate, ongoing reporting through the continuous update and maintenance of necessary reports in Salesforce.com and other tools and applications
  • Provide support for renewal escalations and your assigned districts

Your Experience

  • At least 3+years experience in Managing diverse enterprise renewals /sales teams
  • At least 3+ years experience in leading 8-15 people, in the office and remote work environments
  • At least 3+ years Experience in hiring, developing and retaining talent
  • Proven Experience with channel /partner sales models renewals/ upsells
  • Proven to consistently achieve renewal/ sales team goals through your leadership
  • Proven ability to learn new technology quickly, as well as adapt to changing needs
  • Excellent communication skills -the ability to build cross-functional relationships
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills -the ability to work on many projects concurrently
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce.com skills

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success Regional Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: IT System Engineer
description:
About the role

The role of the IT system engineer can be both challenging and rewarding. This role requires strong technical expertise, along with business acumen, interpersonal skills, and a passion for continuous improvement. As a Systems Engineer, you will be a member of a global IT operations team. Your main responsibilities include designing, implementing, and maintaining IT infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, security, and scalability of our systems, as well as participate in on-call team rotations. Your expertise in infrastructure as code, systems infrastructure, cloud technologies, and network infrastructure will be crucial in driving our success.

This is a FULL Remote position so good home internet is required, and hours will be, Monday - Friday between 8:00AM and 5:00 PM in the employee’s time zone.

Key Responsibilities:

•Infrastructure as Code: Develop and manage infrastructure through automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.

•Systems Infrastructure: Implement and maintain virtualization, containerization (Docker), SAN, BDR, and patch/vulnerability management solutions for Windows and Linux

•Cloud: Manage and optimize cloud services, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, and Exchange Online.

•Network Infrastructure: Design and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewall policy, VPNs (point-to-point and site-to-site), SD-WAN, load balancers, ACLs and NSGs

Qualifications:

•Effective communication in English (oral and written).

•3-5 years’ experience as a Systems Engineer or similar role.

•Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Azure CLI).

•Experience with systems infrastructure technologies (virtualization, containerization, Docker, SAN, BDR, patch/vulnerability management).

•Proficiency in cloud services (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, Exchange Online).

•Solid understanding of network infrastructure (routing, switching, firewall policies, SD-WAN, load balancers, VPNs, ACLs, NSGs).

•Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

•Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

•Self-motivated, take initiative and ownership of your duties

•Enjoy working in a collaborative environment, value mentorship, and can balance priorities

•Team player but can also operate independently

Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience with automation and orchestration tools.

•Familiarity with security best practices and compliance standards.

•Experience working in a global team

title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team.

Role will be based in Sao Paulo, Brazil

We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred

  • Travel Required

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. And as a Snowflake employee, you will be accountable for supporting and enabling diversity and belonging.

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Because traditional on-premises and cloud solutions struggle with this, Snowflake developed an innovative product with a new built-for-the-cloud architecture that combines the power of data warehousing, the flexibility of big data platforms, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions.

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Join to apply for the Finance Reporting Analyst role at Netcracker Technology

If digital transformation , next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams , earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world. .
What is in it for you?
At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren't micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.
What is the scope of this role?
As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Financial Reporting Analyst of Business Profitability Management will provide financial reporting and operational support to Senior Management, Regional General Managers and supporting organizations. Main responsibility is to provide transparency and trustworthy reporting for incoming deals and ongoing projects to help senior management make strategic and tactical decisions for the company. Candidate will be responsible for accuracy in financial reporting, mainly concentrating on actuals and forecast to allow successful completion of strategic initiatives to continuously improve company's profitability and efficiency. In this role, candidate will work closely with operational groups indicating trends, findings, issues and steps needed to ensure data accuracy in the systems and reporting. Additionally, candidate will assist in driving business process and system enhancements related to all aspects of global business to streamline internal processes.
What are the Role and Responsibilities?

  • Global Business Consolidation reporting, analytics and distribution to Executives and Senior Management
  • Support monthly forecasting, actuals and variance analysis
  • Prepare KPI Decks and present all significant bookings, revenue and profit risks to Senior Management
  • Partnering with BPM Managers and analysts on a global scale to identify trends and issues requiring data adjustments to properly reflect Customer Booking, Revenue and Profitability Forecast
  • Review and evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal processes and manage risk by identifying opportunities to strengthen, rewrite and implement new risk conscious business processes
  • Define business requirements, test and implement an extensive ERP-based automated profitability reporting and analysis tool that enhances the accuracy, flexibility and timeliness of profitability forecasting
  • Perform ad-hoc reports and analysis as needed
What skills are required for this role?
  • Strong financial analysis skills with ability to manipulate large data sets in Excel (knowledge of Macros preferred)
  • Experience in Data Analytics, ability to extrapolate trends from large data sets
  • 3+ years combined experience in Financial/Business Operations
  • Profitability / P&L analysis and reporting experience
  • Accounting (US GAAP/IFRS) and Revenue Recognition experience a plus
  • Proficient in PowerBI or other BI tools
  • Hands-on experience in SQL, VBA, Big Data Analytics
  • Experience in use of ERP systems
  • Experience working in large multinational software and/or IT services company
  • A team player, with ability to work independently, as well as cross-functionally at all levels including interfacing with Senior Management
  • Robust communication skills both verbal and written
  • Ability to meet deadlines and satisfy needs with multiple and conflicting priorities
  • Fluent English both written and oral
  • Availability to work from office in Hybrid mode

  • BS in Accounting/Finance, MBA a plus

title: Gerente de Trade Categoria
description:
ID da Requisição: 67594

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.

A equipe da qual você fará parte

A equipe de Propaganda desenvolve estratégias de marketing, merchandising e criativas e programas afiliados para promover os produtos e serviços da organização através da Internet ou outros canais digitais, para aumentar a exposição e os negócios do público-alvo, e analisa a eficácia dessas estratégias.

Resumo desta função

Será responsável por coordenar as estratégias de sell-out da categoria de lavanderia, enfrentando desafios competitivos frente à concorrência e liderando a execução da renovação de 95% do portfólio até fevereiro de 2026. O papel exige visão estratégica, excelência em execução e forte capacidade analítica.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão

  • Desenvolver e liderar estratégias de sell-out nos canais on/off-line para a categoria de lavanderia.
  • Implementar métodos de gestão e soluções criativas para aumentar a competitividade dos produtos.
  • Gerenciar a transição do portfólio, executando o phase-out de modelos antigos e phase-in dos novos até fev/26.
  • Analisar performance de mercado, concorrência e indicadores de sell-out, propondo planos de ação eficazes.
  • Coordenar o relacionamento com áreas internas e parceiros estratégicos do varejo.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre times de marketing, comercial e supply para execução tática e estratégica.
  • Propor ações comerciais para aumentar margem e atratividade da categoria para o varejo.
  • Monitorar KPIs da categoria e ajustar estratégias conforme necessário.

Requisitos mínimos

  • Profissional em nível de gerência consolidado.

  • Experiência prévia sólida em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente em Trade Categoria.

  • Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas de análise de mercado, como Nielsen, GfK, Scanntech, Neogrid e dados internos de BI.

  • Capacidade analítica e estratégica para tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

  • Conhecimento profundo em gestão de sell-out e lançamento de produtos.

Habilidades e experiências desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas reconhecidas pela excelência em Trade Marketing no Brasil, como Ambev, P&G, Unilever, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Heineken, Mondelez, Reckitt e Danone.

  • Histórico de atuação em mercados com alta competitividade e transformação constante de portfólio.

  • Vivência em gestão de projetos multifuncionais envolvendo marketing, vendas e supply chain.

  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e negociação com stakeholders internos e externos.

  • Perfil resiliente, proativo e orientado a resultados, com habilidade de atuar do tático ao estratégico.

  • Inglês avançado nice to have, mas não mandatório.

O que oferecemos

_"No dresscode".
_Gympass;
_Vale-Transporte, Fretados ou Estacionamento na empresa;
_Vale Alimentação;
_Refeição no local;
_Benefícios como empréstimo consignado ou social, plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida e previdência privada compatíveis com o mercado;
_Programa de Apoio ao Empregado, contando com atendimento 24hrs com profissionais jurídicos, sociais, financeiros, assistentes sociais e Psicólogos;
_Auxílio Creche ou Berçário na empresa;

Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.

Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!

description:
Join to apply for the Program Buyer role at Faurecia .

About Forvia : A leader in sustainable mobility technology, pioneering innovative solutions for meaningful mobility experiences.

Your Mission, Roles, and Responsibilities

The Program Buyer anticipates specific requirements for new programs, ensures the commodity panel strategy supports the program, and selects and tests suppliers within the approved supplier panel to meet program objectives. The Program Buyer is part of the core program team.

Main Activities

  • Support Acquisition Buyer during the conception/pre-requisition phase for RFQ approval.
  • Ensure supplier selection aligns with the commodity panel strategy, approve new suppliers via sourcing committee, and negotiate best financial conditions with commodity buyers to meet program and serial life purchase targets.
  • Monitor supplier performance during the program phase: manage suppliers, compare costs to targets, ensure quality, respect delivery deadlines, and close phase reviews (gate reviews) on time as per PMS.
  • Ensure early involvement of commodity buyers before serial phase, involving ASQ and T&E buyers as needed.
  • Manage specific and mandatory suppliers as requested and agreed with clients.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and comply with Faurecia’s Code of Ethics, Environmental, and Quality Policies, along with other assigned duties.

Profile and Competencies

Requirements

  • Complete higher education in Engineering or related fields.
  • Experience in the automotive industry is a plus.
  • Intermediate MS Office skills, especially Excel.
  • Problem-solving skills (QRCI, 8D, etc.).
  • Interpersonal skills and industrial networking ability.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Analytical, conflict resolution, and people management skills.
  • Knowledge of purchasing processes (cost analysis, negotiation, supplier selection matrix).

What We Offer

  • An engaging environment contributing to sustainable mobility technologies.
  • Opportunities for career growth in a global company with over 157,000 employees across 40+ countries.
  • A dynamic, inclusive, and diverse workplace with extensive training programs.
  • Commitment to sustainability, including achieving CO2 Net Zero by 2045, certified under SBTI Net-Zero Standard.

Why Join Us

Faurecia is a pioneering automotive technology group focused on smarter, sustainable mobility, with a history of over a century. We are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, with our technology in about half of all vehicles worldwide. We aim to reach CO2 Net Zero by 2045, leading industry change with innovative solutions for better lives globally.

title: Trading Support Analyst
description:
Who Are We?

Fidessa (an ION Group Company) provides exceptional trading, investment, and information solutions for the world's financial community. Our unrivalled set of mission-critical products serve both buy-side and sell-side global institutions and investment banks to boutique brokers and niche hedge funds with multi-asset trading and investment infrastructure, their market data and analysis, and their decision making and workflow technology.

We are freethinking and do not believe in rigid structure or tight controls that limit our ability to be innovative and adaptable. Our team at Fidessa is represented within several continents in multiple offices. We recognize that a business is only as good as its people. To provide and build on our high-quality platform and services, we seek to employ only the best!

Role

Fidessa's Trading Support Analysts provide functional support for all customer requests across Fidessa's multi-asset product range. This opening has specific focus around the support and training of new and existing users of the Fidessa equities trading and risk management platform. This platform provides high-speed access to global equities exchanges and execution venues and is used by top tier brokers worldwide. Based in São Paulo, this team is part of the Fidessa Global Service Desk and is formed of an enthusiastic mix of individuals with strong technical, functional, and customer service skills, looking for a challenging and varied role in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent grad or someone with up to 4 years of experience who wants direct interaction with clients and trading floors, exposure to complex financial products, and a career pathway in trade support, product management, or technical account management.

Responsibilities

In order to meet the requirements of the customer base and the diverse needs of the evolving trading landscape, the Trading Support team caters to the immediate needs of our customers, resolving a high percentage of issues independently and liaising with specialist groups within the business and technology to ensure fast resolution of issues that require additional coordination to resolve. In addition to providing real-time phone, chat, and e-mail support, Trading Support Analysts also conduct regular on-site customer visits to provide product training and support for Fidessa users. These visits provide valuable ground-level insight on how customers are using Fidessa services and can be leveraged to introduce solutions that will help improve customer workflows through new and existing Fidessa solutions. Travel will be required but will be typically less than 25% (when things stabilize after post COVID-19).

Required Experience and Competencies

  • At least 1 year of experience in equities trading operations, including basic knowledge of the equity markets and an understanding of equity business flows. Recent grads with significant internship experience in equities trading operations, equity markets, and equity business flows will also be considered.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating the ability to communicate succinctly and accurately to customers.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering concentration (Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering) with a business focus OR Business-related degree with significant exposure to Information Systems, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering.
  • Self-motivated and positive attitude.
  • Strong customer service ability.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations in a trading environment.
  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English (PLEASE PROVIDE RESUME IN ENGLISH).

Desired Experience and Competencies

  • Experience supporting Software as a Service platforms.
  • Knowledge of financial software platforms.
  • Spoken and written communication skills in Spanish.

About ION

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. More than 40% of the world’s largest companies use our solutions. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading, and risk.

Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

With 10,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe, ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group.

At ION, we offer careers that provide many opportunities: To invent. To design. To collaborate. To build. To transform businesses and empower people around the world to do more, faster and better than before. Imagine what you can do and experience. This is where you can do your best work.

Learn more at iongroup.com .

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.

ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

title: Associate Director, Sales
description:
Overview

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced Associate Director, Sales to lead Shure’s sales strategy across South America, while also overseeing the Brazil-based Channel Marketing and Customer Experience teams serving the entire Latin American region. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through high-performing channel partnerships, developing go-to-market strategies, strengthening partner engagement, and ensuring alignment with Shure’s brand and business objectives, while helping to shape long-term objectives, uncovering new opportunities, and enhancing the end-user experience.

If you have a strong background in sales and marketing team leadership, a deep understanding of the Latin America channel ecosystem, and a proven ability to build collaborative relationships that drive customer success, apply now!

Fluency in English. Spanish and Portuguese is a requirement for this role.

This role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities
  • Leads the South America sales organization, owning sales performance, growth targets, and margin improvement. Develops and executes strategic plans to exceed annual sales targets across all product lines.
  • Provides hands-on leadership to the Sales, Channel Marketing, and Customer Experience teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and performance across South America and broader Latin America. Sets clear goals, coaches team members, and fosters a culture of innovation and professional development.
  • Manages strategic channel accounts directly, with a focus on growth, value creation, and improving the customer journey. Builds long-term relationships with top partners and ensure alignment with brand and business strategies.
  • Oversees the execution of regional channel marketing and customer engagement initiatives in collaboration with the Brazil-based team supporting Latin America. Ensures programs are effective, aligned with sales objectives, and contributes to partner enablement and customer success.
  • Drives the development and execution of regional channel sales plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Identifies gaps, opportunities, and improvements to increase market penetration and partner performance.
  • Collaborates with internal teams (e.g., product marketing, global accounts, operations) to support successful regional promotions, launches, events, and training programs that increase brand visibility and market share.
  • Represents the voice of the Latin America channel partners internally. Provides strategic input into global and regional initiatives to ensure relevance and impact. Leads regional special projects that support business transformation.
  • Owns budgeting and forecasting for the regional teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives and responsible financial stewardship.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • Minimum 10–12 years of experience in sales and/or channel leadership.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience managing people and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of the professional audio or AV industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working with channel ecosystems in Latin America.
  • Ability to manage complexity, drive execution, and lead in a matrixed organization.
  • Proficient in Salesforce and/or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to engage with senior leadership.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to inspire, motivate, and empower diverse teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 75% of the time.
  • Languages: Fluency in English. Spanish and Portuguese required

WHO WE ARE

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for nearly a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

THE MIX MATTERS

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!
